name: carry
description: Code home for Carry, Salman Asif's personal design system. packages/carry-ds is canonical; everything else is tooling around it.

scripts.ci: pnpm check:release && pnpm check:deps && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.render:examples: for f in packages/carry-content/examples/*.json; do node packages/carry-render/bin/carry-render.mjs "$f" --all || exit 1; done
